name: permapath-mcp

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Where a PermaPath link points now, its status, and its full change history. Anyone can look up any link; no key needed.

link_id.description: The 43-character link ID (the part after ?l= in a PermaPath QR link).

tools.name: get_scans
tools.description: How many times a link's QR code has been scanned (total and per day, UTC). Only links with scan counting on are counted.

link_id.description: The 43-character link ID (the part after ?l= in a PermaPath QR link).

tools.name: get_qr_svg
tools.description: The QR code for a link as SVG markup (print-ready, with the link's saved design). Save it to a .svg file to print or share.

link_id.description: The 43-character link ID (the part after ?l= in a PermaPath QR link).

tools.name: draft_link
tools.description: A link that opens PermaPath with a new link (or a change to one of the user's links) already filled in. The user checks it and taps Create or Save, so their own key signs it; no key needed here. Use this when no key is configured, or the user would rather approve each change. Give the user the url.

link_id.description: Only to change an existing link: its 43-character ID. Omit to create a new link.

type.description: What the link opens (default: a web address).

text.description: Page text, or a contact card's note, or an event's details.

start.description: Event start, ISO 8601 local time, e.g. 2026-11-01T19:00

off_at.description: ISO 8601 date and time to turn off.

message.description: Shown while the link is off.

ios.description: Other destination for iPhone and iPad users.

rules.description: Routing rules: { to, os?, after?, before?, days?, from?, until? }; first match wins.

qr.description: QR design: { fg, bg, transparent, style: square|rounded, label, frame: square|rounded|bar, icon, sturdy }.

tools.name: suggest_feature
tools.description: Send a feature suggestion to the PermaPath team when the user wants something PermaPath can't do. Ask the user first and show them the text you'll send; include their email only if they offer it (to be told when it's done). Private: never published.

text.description: What the user would like PermaPath to do, in plain words.

email.description: Optional, only if the user wants to be told when it's done.

instructions: PermaPath links are permanent QR codes whose destination can be changed later. No key is configured, so only read-only tools are available. Give users the qr_url to print; it never changes.
